definitions.gloss: overall length; total length; full length
definitions.explanation: The complete length of something measured from one end to the other.

examples.japanese: この{橋|はし}の{全長|ぜんちょう}は{約|やく}500メートルだ。
examples.english: The total length of this bridge is about 500 meters.

examples.japanese: この{蛇|へび}は{全長|ぜんちょう}3メートルにもなる。
examples.english: This snake reaches an overall length of 3 meters.

examples.japanese: {全長|ぜんちょう}100キロメートルの{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}が{来年|らいねん}{開通|かいつう}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: A highway with a total length of 100 kilometers is scheduled to open next year.

notes:
A compound of {全|ぜん} (all, complete) and {長|ちょう} (length). Used for measuring the full extent of physical objects such as vehicles, bridges, tunnels, rivers, and animals. Commonly appears in specifications, descriptions, and technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全長|ぜんちょう}〜メートル: ~ meters in total length
- {全長|ぜんちょう}〜キロ: ~ kilometers long
- {全長|ぜんちょう}が{約|やく}〜: approximately ~ in total length
- {車|くるま}の{全長|ぜんちょう}: the overall length of a car

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {全幅|ぜんぷく}: overall width — the width counterpart to {全長|ぜんちょう}
- {全高|ぜんこう}: overall height — the height counterpart
- {長|なが}さ: length — the general, everyday word for length
